name: What is the process for replacing an exterior door?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing an exterior door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with a consultation to select the door style, material, and features. Once the door is ordered and arrives, our team will prepare the opening by carefully removing the old door and, if necessary, the old frame. The new door unit is then installed, ensuring it is plumb, level, and square. We then insulate around the frame, install trim, and ensure all hardware operates correctly. The final step involves cleanup and a walkthrough with the homeowner to ensure satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, door selection, removal of the old door/frame, installation of the new unit, insulation, trim, hardware setup, and a final walkthrough.
